decisions.decision: Structural regroup only: the six source-page units keep their source order and internal order, but are no longer one chapter per source page. They are grouped under one level-1 chapter with the source page headings as level-2/3 minor sections that flow; no content block was reordered.

The non-source 'SOURCE PAGE n' kickers are removed. One short source note on the opening section's closing paragraph names the source, its six A4 pages and the durable record; all further provenance stays in authoring/record.json.

The source's sentence 'A sample is a bounded piece of material selected for inspection.' is kept inside its own source paragraph instead of being split into a definition, because the source does not mark it as a labelled definition. Meaning, wording and order are unchanged.
The page-6 plate remains unresolved; no OCR, label, date, place, warrant or plausible name was added.

The source's labelled definitions, case note, quotation and 'A short check' are retained as definition, case, quote and assessment blocks with their wording preserved; no other teaching apparatus is present.
The source's two tables carry the source's values and are retained as tables. No chart, diagram, summary, glossary list, exercise, reading list or outside enrichment was added.
The plate is the public-safe synthetic raster extracted unchanged from page 6 of the supplied fixture; its rights record names the fixture, marks it verified and carries the extracted file hash.
No source page or readable passage was excluded; every page is covered and every block is named in coverage or a derivation.

Only the full plate unit is given an explicit breakBefore: page, so heading, unresolved note, image, caption and credit stay on one deliberate page. No other source heading forces a page break and there is no page quota.
